headline: Fisherman's Row Surges as Weathered Expanse Holds Hot
war_summary: Since the 21:20 edition the wires show renewed movement at Fisherman's Row with nine changes in two hours to 23:55 for thirty-five on the day about Arcadia, Eidolo and Black Well, still standing nine Colonial, while the Weathered Expanse added six changes to the cutoff for thirty-three on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk at four Warden to five Colonial, and Stlican Shelf added four changes to the cutoff for thirty-one on the day about Fort Hoarfrost, the Pale House and the Old Mourn at five Warden to three Colonial with one neutral. Tempest Island records four changes to the cutoff about Reef, still nine Colonial. Godcrofts with sixty-two on the day to 19:29, Linn Mercy with ten to 20:20, Marban Hollow with five to 22:10, Deadlands with six to 19:55, Stonecradle with nine to 17:30, Mooring County with nine to 15:44 and Farranac Coast with six to 15:44 have gone quiet in the last two hours despite heavy twenty-four-hour losses in Mooring, Stonecradle, Farranac and Callahan's Passage, the latter holding ten Warden with no flips.
